# Clarification-request phrases for ParseStatus.CLARIFICATION detection.
#
# Aligned with Aliannejadi et al. (2019) "Asking Clarifying Questions in
# Open-Domain Information-Seeking Conversations" (SIGIR), which is the
# canonical taxonomy of clarification-request patterns in conversational AI.
# Extended with patterns observed for the noisy-instruction setting by
# Wang et al. (2023) "Resilience of Large Language Models for Noisy
# Instructions" (the primary empirical reference for this study's ICR metric).
#
# All entries are matched whole-word, case-insensitive. The proxy is
# intentionally conservative: it under-counts rather than over-counts.
# ICR is a diagnostic metric (design/04 §4.5), not a primary endpoint.
# The UNPARSEABLE bucket absorbs any missed cases; accuracy is unaffected.
#
# Implements: design/04 §4.5, ParseStatus.CLARIFICATION detection

# --- Direct requests for clarification or specification (Aliannejadi §3.1) ---
could you clarify
can you clarify
please clarify
could you be more specific
can you be more specific
please be more specific
could you specify
could you define what you mean
could you elaborate
can you elaborate
could you explain what you mean
could you restate
could you rephrase
can you rephrase

# --- Understanding checks (Aliannejadi §3.2) ---
what do you mean
what do you mean by
what exactly do you mean
what exactly are you asking
what are you asking
what are you referring to
not sure what you mean
not sure what you're asking
not sure what you want
i'm not sure what you mean
i'm not sure what you're asking
i'm not sure i understand
i'm not sure i understand what
i'm unclear on what
i'm unclear about what
i'm unclear on
i'm having trouble understanding
i don't understand what you mean
i do not understand what you mean
i don't understand what you're asking
i do not understand what you're asking

# --- Information and context requests (Aliannejadi §3.3) ---
i need more context
i need more information
i need more details
could you provide more details
can you provide more details
could you provide more context
can you provide more context
could you provide more information
can you provide more information
please provide more context
please provide more information
more context would help
more information would help
more details would help
is there additional context
is there any additional information
is there any more context
could you share more about

# --- Disambiguation requests (Aliannejadi §3.4) ---
the question is unclear
this question is unclear
the problem is unclear
this problem is unclear
the question seems ambiguous
the problem seems ambiguous
this seems ambiguous
the statement is ambiguous
the problem statement is ambiguous
are you asking
which do you mean
which one do you mean
did you mean
do you mean
would you like me to
what would you like me to
